senses.gloss: --the commander of Mura's forces; killed by कृष्ण. भा. X. ५९. १२-14.

--a pedestal (base) on which the image is installed; here must be provided a प्रणालक to let water flow; ten kinds of पीठिकस् distinguished; श्थण्डित, वापी, यक्षी, वेदी, मण्डला, पूर्णचन्द्रा, वज्रा, पद्मा, Ardha- शासी, and त्रिकोण,
1: M. २६२. 1-7.
these may be made of stone, earth, or wood according to the Linga.
2: Ib. २६२. १९-20; २६९. 8.
